decision: Retain four-tap relief compaction only on Compatibility/Forward+ contact programs without admitted Natural transitions; Mobile keeps its original source. Preserve baseline numerical residuals and the Android sampler-budget limitation; V1 remains default-off.
implementation: One uniform-bound loop performs the same four painted-relief samples with identical coordinates, explicit gradients and downstream arithmetic. The albedo and mean samples remain separate. This differs from the rejected five/six-color loops.

Only Compatibility/Forward+ non-admitted-Natural contact variants use compaction. Existing Natural pair/junction programs, resource ownership, geometry, atlas data, controls and defaults retain their previous behavior.
The internal loop bound defaults to four and is not a player setting. No additional sampler, texture, pass or image asset.
The benchmark fixtures now guard the optional footprint node; --no-deform previously dereferenced null in a release runtime.
